package.description: Agent 友好的文献管理方式。

en-US.longDescription: Traditional reference managers are not agent-friendly: highlights and notes stay locked inside single files, making it hard for agents to reuse knowledge across papers; every conversation starts from scratch without a stable local knowledge map; PDFs are human-friendly but not the most comfortable reading material for agents. Agentero aims to build an agent-friendly, agent-native way to manage references, exploring how humans and agents collaborate on reference management. Connect your local agent via ACP (BYOA), select-text chat, import papers and Skills, stay compatible with the Zotero ecosystem, and get paper translation, bidirectional links with a knowledge graph, and deep PDF reading.
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release extends Agent replies from plain Markdown to read-only structured UI blocks, turns PDF selection translation into a pinnable floating card, and lets Plaza feed items go straight to the Agent. It also adds CLI feed subscriptions and OR keyword matching for discover, and fixes a batch of issues across Zotero migration, Plaza embedded pages, quick conversations, and the PDF translation pipeline.
Features
- Read-only UI blocks in Agent replies: A standalone openui-lang fence at the start of a line is parsed into read-only components spanning layout, text, status, data, paper reading, and flow; colors follow theme tokens, charts stay legible in the 320px rail, and the component signatures ship with the bundled skill. (#1007 by @ffy6511)
- Floating translation cards for PDF selections: Translations appear in a floating card that can be moved, resized, and copied, and stays visible while scrolling or zooming; Esc closes it and P pins it, the header previews the source text and jumps back to the selection, and each viewer keeps one card at a time. (#974 by @ffy6511)
- Add whole Plaza feed items to a conversation: The RSS list context menu and the detail toolbar gain "Add to chat", sending the whole item (title plus summary or full text) to the Composer as a reference chip. (#955 by @HenryLoveMiller)
- CLI feed commands: New agentero feed list/add/remove/refresh/items/read subcommands share the desktop fetch pipeline and feeds.sqlite, return stable error codes, and support incremental cron consumption. (#969 by @HenryLoveMiller)
Improvements
- Antigravity now uses native agy acp: The standalone ACP server download is gone; Agentero reuses the local agy acp and its existing login state, and the macOS Intel restriction is lifted. (#1011 by @bet4it)
- Markdown source toggle moved to the status bar: The rendered/source switch is pinned to the left edge of the editor status bar, the duplicate entries in both toolbars are gone, and the shortcut tooltip and pressed state remain. (163eb4ea6 by @ffy6511)
- OR keywords for CLI discover: --match any (MCP keywordMatch) joins multiple keywords with OR so multi-word radar scans no longer collapse to zero results; the default stays AND. (#971 by @HenryLoveMiller)
Fixes
- Plaza pages fit their panel and support zoom: Embedded pages scale to the panel width by default, the toolbar offers 25%–200% manual zoom, and clicking the percentage restores auto-fit; resizing does not remount the iframe. (#1005 by @W-RMSL)
- Plaza pages survive tab switches: An activated embedded page stays mounted across workspace tab switches and split-pane focus changes, keeping the iframe and in-page state; background tabs still load lazily. (#989 by @W-RMSL)
- Zotero migration stopped by path checks: When a new vault sits under the home directory, the ancestor probe now stops at the filesystem scope boundary instead of raising forbidden path. (#996 by @YasyaKarasu)
- Quick conversations stay visible and resizable: The card remains after the pointer leaves, scrolling, or zooming the PDF, can be dragged to resize, and lets long formulas scroll horizontally within window bounds. (#992 by @Aschenbath)
- Business journal rankings are retained: FMS and UTD24 values returned by EasyScholar survive the tag projection, and a duplicated UTD24 listing is shown once. (#1013 by @Aschenbath)
- Mermaid and tables in Agent replies: Mermaid fences now use the shared renderer, and table fullscreen opens an in-app overlay closed with Esc. (176bfeda2 / 4f5f2a8c5 by @ffy6511)
- Local skills appear in the / menu: The slash menu merges the local SKILL.md list, inserts a skill token when picked, and keeps ACP commands ahead on name collisions. (cc8e7634f by @ffy6511)
- ACP command prefixes are preserved: Commands are inserted and sent in the advertised $name form, so agents that only accept $skill no longer reject /skill. (21497e578 by @ffy6511)
- Minimized windows can be summoned again: On Windows, reopening Settings or another singleton window from the gear restores, shows, and focuses it. (1138d198a by @ffy6511)
- Deleting a paper no longer leaves a catalog row: Entries whose folder is already gone are removed with the delete, so the paper stops showing as missing a PDF. (75aa1fb7f by @qychen2001)
- Citation pills stay readable in light themes: Removing the muted text override keeps citation pills from rendering as black blocks under the Twitter light theme. (#990 by @W-RMSL)
- Numbered formulas can be located: Formula numbers are read from \tag{N} in the layout data, so #formula=N resolves even when an older index omits the formula. (92c4aae28 by @ffy6511)
Resolved Issues
- No progress in the dual-pane translator: The split translation panel now reports translation progress instead of leaving a blank pane on long documents. (#994 by @ffy6511)
- Full-text translation failed in the split view: Rendering waits for the translated display document to be ready, so full-text translation no longer errors or leaves a blank page in the split view. (#991 by @ffy6511)
- Quick-chat replies were lost: A marks refresh no longer replaces the live thread with a catalog snapshot, so generated replies survive the refresh. (#945 by @ffy6511)
Full diff: https://github.com/poco-ai/Agentero/compare/v0.15.2...v0.15.3

zh-CN.description: Agent 友好的文献管理方式。
zh-CN.longDescription: 传统文献管理器对 Agent 并不友好：阅读高亮和笔记被锁在单篇文件里，Agent 很难跨论文复用；每次对话都要重新提供上下文，缺少稳定的本地知识地图；PDF 对人友好，但对 Agent 来讲不是最舒服的阅读材料。Agentero 旨在构建 Agent 友好、Agent 原生的文献管理方式，探索人与 Agent 在文献管理中的协作方式。通过 ACP 连接本机 Agent（BYOA），支持划词对话、论文导入与 Skill 导入，兼容 Zotero 生态，提供论文翻译、双链与知识图谱、PDF 深度阅读等功能。
zh-CN.name: Agentero
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
本次发布把 Agent 回复从纯 Markdown 扩展到只读结构化 UI 块，PDF 划词翻译改为可固定、可拖动的浮卡，广场订阅条目可以直接交给 Agent；同时补齐 CLI 的订阅源命令与 discover 关键词 OR 能力，并修复 Zotero 迁移、广场嵌入页、快速对话和 PDF 翻译链路的一批问题。
新功能
- Agent 回复中的只读 UI 块：助手回复里行首独立的 openui-lang 围栏会解析成只读组件，覆盖布局、文本、状态、数据、论文阅读与流程；配色跟随主题 token，图表在 320px 侧栏内仍可读，组件签名随内置 skill 下发。（#1007 by @ffy6511）
- PDF 划词翻译浮卡：翻译结果以浮卡显示，可拖动、缩放和复制，滚动或缩放 PDF 时保留；Esc 关闭、P 固定，顶部预览原文并可跳回选区，同一阅读器只保留一张卡片。（#974 by @ffy6511）
- 广场订阅条目加入对话：RSS 列表的右键菜单和详情页工具栏新增「加入对话」，整条条目（标题与摘要或全文）作为引用 chip 直接进入 Composer。（#955 by @HenryLoveMiller）
- CLI 订阅源命令：新增 agentero feed list/add/remove/refresh/items/read 六个子命令，与桌面端共享抓取管线和 feeds.sqlite，返回稳定错误码，支持 cron 增量拉取。（#969 by @HenryLoveMiller）
改进
- Antigravity 改用原生 agy acp: 不再下载独立的 ACP server，直接复用本机 agy acp 与已有登录态，并解除 macOS Intel 的架构限制。（#1011 by @bet4it）
- Markdown 源码切换收进状态栏：渲染与源码的切换固定在编辑器状态栏左端，两处工具栏的重复入口移除，快捷键提示与按下状态保留。（163eb4ea6 by @ffy6511）
- CLI discover 支持关键词 OR: --match any（MCP 对应 keywordMatch）把多个关键词用 OR 合并，多词雷达不再召回归零，默认仍是 AND。（#971 by @HenryLoveMiller）
修复
- 广场嵌入页适应面板并支持缩放：默认等比适配面板宽度，工具栏提供 25%–200% 手动缩放，点击百分比恢复自动适应，尺寸变化不重载 iframe。（#1005 by @W-RMSL）
- 切换标签不再丢广场页面：已激活的嵌入页在切换工作区标签或分屏焦点后保持挂载，iframe 与页内状态不丢，后台标签仍按需加载。（#989 by @W-RMSL）
- Zotero 迁移不再被路径检查中断：选择主目录下的新知识库时，父目录探测停在文件访问范围边界，不再抛 forbidden path。（#996 by @YasyaKarasu）
- 快速对话保持常显且可调整：指针离开、滚动或缩放 PDF 后卡片仍在，可拖拽改变大小，长公式可横向滚动并受窗口边界约束。（#992 by @Aschenbath）
- 经管期刊等级不再丢失：EasyScholar 返回的 FMS 与 UTD24 在标签投影时保留，同一收录值只显示一次。（#1013 by @Aschenbath）
- Agent 回复里的 Mermaid 与表格：Mermaid 围栏改用共享渲染器；表格全屏改为应用内浮层，Esc 关闭。（176bfeda2 / 4f5f2a8c5 by @ffy6511）
- 本地技能出现在 / 菜单：斜杠菜单合并本地 SKILL.md 列表，选中后插入技能 token，ACP 命令仍优先。（cc8e7634f by @ffy6511）
- ACP 命令前缀保持原样：按 agent 声明的 $name 形式插入和发送，只认 $skill 的 agent 不再拒绝 /skill。（21497e578 by @ffy6511）
- 最小化窗口可以重新唤起：Windows 下从齿轮再次打开设置等单例窗口时，先恢复、显示再聚焦。（1138d198a by @ffy6511）
- 删除论文不再残留 catalog 行：文件夹已不存在的条目会在删除时一并清理，不再长期显示为缺少 PDF。（75aa1fb7f by @qychen2001）
- 浅色主题下引用标签可读：去掉 muted 文字色覆盖，Twitter 浅色主题下引用标签不再显示为黑块。（#990 by @W-RMSL）
- 编号公式可以定位：公式编号从 layout 的 \tag{N} 解析，旧索引缺少公式时 #formula=N 也能找到页内公式。（92c4aae28 by @ffy6511）
已解决问题
- 分栏翻译没有进度：双栏翻译面板现在显示翻译进度，长文档翻译时不再只剩空白面板。（#994 by @ffy6511）
- 全文翻译分栏报错：渲染前等待译文显示文档就绪，全文翻译不再因分栏报错或出现空白页。（#991 by @ffy6511）
- 快速对话回复丢失：marks 刷新不再用语料库快照覆盖进行中的问答，已生成的回复在刷新后仍在。（#945 by @ffy6511）
Full diff: https://github.com/poco-ai/Agentero/compare/v0.15.2...v0.15.3
